title: Outrun Hunger 2026
description: Outrun Hunger 2026 5k Fun Run/Walk to support the Dawson Community Food Bank & Thrift. The Dawson Community Food Bank & Thrift, located at 92 Chestatee Industrial Park Drive in Dahlonega, is conducting a 5k Fun Run/Walk called Outrun Hunger on October 24th. Registration will begin at 8AM and the event will start at 9AM. This food bank is the largest in the Georgia Mountain Food Bank network and supports over 3,000 families per month. 900 of which are from Lumpkin County. It is a 501c3 charity and relies on donations to support it's mission. Participants can sign up at https://runsignup.com/Rac

title: Bark in the Park
description: Bark in the Park Join TLC Humane Society for the 15th Annual Bark in the Park , our largest fundraiser of the year, on Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. at Hancock Park in Dahlonega . This free, family-friendly, and pet-friendly festival brings the community together for an afternoon of fun while supporting homeless dogs and cats in our area. Enjoy live music, local vendors, delicious food, a bake sale, pet adoptions, raffles, a pet costume contest, and activities for all ages. Leashed pets are welcome! title: Firearm Safety Class
description: Firearm Safety Class Retired Major Ramsey with the Lumpkin County Sheriff's Office will be teaching the Firearm Safety Course from 6-9 pm at the Lumpkin County Sheriff's Office. The course is offered at no cost for the following: 1) residents of Lumpkin County 18 years and older or 2) a student that attends school in Lumpkin County (18 years and older) or 3) works in Lumpkin County. To register for the class, contact Mitzi Deaton at (706) 482-2628 or via email at mitzi.deaton@lumpkincounty.gov **Bring your driver's license and a pen for notes.
